description: The values that define District 38 are rooted in faith and a deep respect for the sanctity of human life. These are not just personal convictions for me. They are the bedrock of the community I am honored to represent, and they shaped my work throughout the 114th General Assembly.On the issue of life, we strengthened protections for pregnant women and unborn children, ensuring that when a woman chooses life, the support she needs is available to her.
